name: Vinnie Paul
description: '''Vincent Paul Abbott'''  (March 11, 1964 – June 22, 2018) was an American musician and drummer. He co-founded the [[heavy metal music|heavy metal]] bands [[Pantera]] and [[Damageplan]] with his younger brother, [[Dimebag Darrell|"Dimebag" Darrell Abbott]].  He was a member of [[Hellyeah]] for 12 years from 2006 until his death in 2018. Several outlets have ranked Abbott among the greatest metal drummers of all time.
